questions.prompt: Which battle in 1066 preceded the Battle of Hastings by weeks?
questions.fact: Harold marched his army about 300 kilometres between the two battles, which is a plausible reason he lost the second.

questions.prompt: Which part of the brain regulates breathing and heart rate?
questions.fact: It runs these functions without conscious input, which is why you cannot hold your breath until you pass out and stay out.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a move called the Fosbury Flop?
questions.fact: It only became possible once landing pits changed from sand and sawdust to deep foam.

questions.prompt: Which director made the films Kill Bill and Reservoir Dogs?
questions.fact: He sold his first screenplay for fifty thousand dollars and used the money to fund his own directing debut.

questions.prompt: Which strait lies between Denmark and Sweden?
questions.fact: A bridge and tunnel cross it, switching from one to the other on an artificial island built for the purpose.

questions.prompt: Who wrote One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest?
questions.fact: He drew on night shifts at a psychiatric hospital, where he had volunteered for government drug trials.

questions.prompt: Which protocol secures web traffic with encryption?
questions.fact: It replaced SSL, though almost everyone still calls certificates SSL certificates out of habit.
